fields.name: Pettenderly
fields.short_description: Create a digital keepsake of your cat or dog with Pettenderly. Its AI studio transforms pet photos into watercolor, royal and other portrait styles.
fields.description:
[Pettenderly](https://pettenderly.com/) is a browser-based studio for making AI portraits from pet photos. Pet owners can upload one to five clear reference photos of the same animal and choose a visual style, including watercolor, royal costumes and studio portraits. The finished result is a digital image that can be downloaded and revisited in My creations.

Two beta features extend the workflow: You & your pet combines separate person and pet photos into a shared portrait, while photo cleanup accepts a written request to change an image. Generated faces, markings and small details can vary.

The service is paid. A one-time Starter Pack costs $4.99 for 12 credits; Pro subscriptions provide 40 credits per month. Each successful generation uses one credit, and failed generations do not use credits. Portraits are delivered as digital files rather than physical prints.
